hotspots.title: Trump Administration's Policy Controversies and Legal Challenges
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces intense pushback over aggressive policy decisions, including mass ACA coverage cancellations, defunding minority and refugee programs, and weaponizing executive authority. Meanwhile, House Democrats have introduced 26 new articles of impeachment amidst legal defenses of controversial DOJ firings.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to heightened fear and outrage over unilateral executive actions targeting vulnerable groups and constitutional boundaries.

hotspots.blurb: President Trump made high-visibility appearances at the Presidents Cup golf tournament and a marquee college football game in Tennessee. The visits sparked polarized crowd reactions—ranging from cheers to audible boos—alongside intense security measures and Air Force One flyovers.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate focus centers on the spectacle of Trump's public reception in cultural arenas, highlighting deep societal polarization.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes Xi Jinping Summit
hotspots.blurb: President Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House and National Archives, resulting in bilateral agreements on AI safety communication channels and trade discussions. Media coverage focused heavily on the geopolitical implications and strategic maneuvering between the two superpowers.
hotspots.affect: The high diplomatic stakes and global economic implications fuel intense speculation and scrutiny from commentators across the spectrum.

hotspots.title: Trump vs. Mainstream Media Conflict
hotspots.blurb: Tension between the White House and press outlets escalated following decisions to ban specific news organizations like CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from briefings. Commentators and journalists warn of an intensifying campaign against the free press and independent reporting.
hotspots.affect: Attacks on journalism evoke strong alarm and indignation regarding constitutional press protections and presidential overreach.

hotspots.title: AI Risks and Trump's Tech Embrace
hotspots.blurb: High-level discussions surrounding artificial intelligence reached the Oval Office as Trump prepared to dine with Anthropic's CEO while framing AI as 'super intelligence.' Concurrently, whistleblower warnings and new bilateral AI safety agreements highlight growing anxieties over rapid technological rollout.
hotspots.affect: The combination of existential technological dread and top-tier political maneuvering creates an urgent, fear-laden narrative.
